name: ataxia, early-onset, with oculomotor apraxia and hypoalbuminemia
description: A rare autosomal recessive cerebellar ataxia (ARCA), characterized by progressive cerebellar ataxia associated with oculomotor apraxia, severe neuropathy, and hypoalbuminemia.
